title: Track a Forgotten File
description: A file was created but forgotten before the commit. Find it, track it, and include it in the repository.
hints: Git can show you the difference between files it is already tracking and files that exist in the workspace but have not been added to the repository yet. Look closely at the status output.
Once you identify the forgotten file, make sure it is staged before creating the commit. After the commit, verify that Git no longer reports any pending changes.

intro.message: I think I forgot to include an important file in the repository. Can you find it and make sure it gets committed?

stageFile.message: Nice! The forgotten file is staged and ready to be committed.

createCommit.message: Great! The forgotten file is now part of the repository history.

success.message: Nice work! You found the forgotten file and safely added it to the repository.

failure.message: Something is still missing. Check the Git status and make sure the forgotten file is committed.
